name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd
about: Navin Fluorine International Ltd is primary engaged in producing refrigeration gases, inorganic fluorides, specialty organofluorines and offers contract research and manufacturing services. [1] Its portfolio includes 50+ fluorinated compounds developed over the years. [2]

business.what: Navin Fluorine makes fluorine-based chemicals across three verticals: HPP (refrigerant gases, AHF, HFO supply), Specialty Chemicals, and CDMO. Revenue comes from product sales, including long-term supply contracts such as the Solstice HFO contract.

segments.name: HPP (high-performance products: refrigerant gases, AHF, HFO)
segments.comment: Healthy growth from higher volumes, better realisation and improved AHF utilisation.

segments.name: Specialty Chemicals
segments.comment: Healthy growth from MPP debottlenecking and new molecules; H2 order visibility strong.

segments.name: CDMO
segments.comment: Strong momentum; FY27 target within reach, order book near USD100 million.

kpis.name: Net operating working capital days, H1 FY27

ledger.promise: FY26 EBITDA margin to hit or cross 30%
ledger.quote: This year, clearly, as you will see the numbers and the math will be in front of you, that we would be hitting or crossing the 30% number, yes.
ledger.actual: FY26 EBITDA 1,082 on revenue 3,314 = 32.6% margin. Q3 FY26 34.5%, Q4 FY26 34.2%.

ledger.promise: Annualized EBITDA margin around 30% ±200 bps (later restated for FY27; Q1 FY27 lifted normalized range to 32-33% ±1%)
ledger.quote: So it will be an annualized number that we are looking at 30% give or take plus/minus 200 basis points.
ledger.actual: H1 FY27 EBITDA 764 on revenue 2,236 = 34.2%, above the top of the 28-32% band. 34.2% in each of Q4 FY26, Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27.

ledger.promise: Commission incremental HFC capacity up to 15,000 MTPA R32 in Q3 FY27
ledger.quote: the CAPEX for incremental HFC capacity equivalent up to 15,000 MTPA of R32 is progressing as planned and is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
ledger.actual: Reaffirmed on Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27 calls. Q2 FY27 call: 'on track for commissioning shortly', full ramp-up possibly in Q4 FY27. Not yet commissioned as of the Nov 2026 call.

ledger.promise: Complete Chemours project in Q1 FY27
ledger.quote: the Chemours Project is progressing well and is on track for completion in Q1 FY27.
ledger.actual: Moved to end June/early July (Q4 FY26 call), then end Q2 FY27 (Q1 FY27 call), then Q3 FY27 (Q2 FY27 call). That is three delays; the stated reason is process selection.

ledger.promise: Commission Dahej MPP de-bottlenecking in Q3 FY27
ledger.quote: the de-bottlenecking of MPP capacity at our Dahej facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27
ledger.actual: Reaffirmed on Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27 calls. The Q2 FY27 commitments do not mention it. Q3 FY27 is still in progress.

ledger.promise: Nectar: about 50% of par in FY26, then secure the other half, or come close, in FY27
ledger.quote: we are working to secure the other half. If not other half, we should be pretty close. That is what our aim is.
ledger.actual: Q4 FY26 call: 75-80% by end FY28, citing a client scope change. Q2 FY27 call: 60-65% of PAR in FY27, with the balance in FY28.

ledger.promise: CDMO revenue of USD 100 million in FY27
ledger.quote: As we look into coming into our FY27 number that we've always said of $100 million, this number that we've delivered this year of INR541 crores is again a solid sort of journey
ledger.actual: FY26 CDMO revenue was 541. Q1 FY27 call: 'very much on track'. On the Q2 FY27 call the target is described partly as 'order book visibility'. There is no segment revenue data to check it.

ledger.promise: Full optimum utilization of cGMP-4 Phase-1 plant in FY27
ledger.quote: Within the year…in FY27, you will see full optimum utilization.
ledger.actual: No utilization figures disclosed. Phase 2 (125 crore) is due by end Q4 FY27. Phase 5 will only be triggered when GMP utilization reaches 70-80% (Q2 FY27 call).

ledger.promise: Specialty revenue of about 350 crore per quarter (Q3 FY26 level) as the run rate going forward
ledger.quote: has reported a number of Rs.350 crores, which in some sense sets up a solid run rate of what we should expect the specialty business to deliver going forward.
ledger.actual: No segment data. Q1 FY27 call cites pricing pressure, especially in LatAm. Q2 FY27 call says the business 'will become' a 350 crore business, which suggests the run rate was not held.

ledger.promise: Net working capital of 75-80 days going forward (previously 90 days)
ledger.quote: Going forward, the net working capital is expected to be in the range of 75 to 80 days versus our previous indicative guidance of 90 days of sales.
ledger.actual: Cash conversion cycle was 89 days in FY25 and 60 days in FY26, already better than the guide. There is no FY27 working-capital data yet.

ledger.promise: cGMP-4 Phase 2 (125 crore, internal accruals) operational by Q4 FY27
ledger.quote: Phase 2 cGMP 4 capex of INR125 crores funded through internal accruals, expected to operationalize by Q4 FY '27.
ledger.actual: Q2 FY27 call: 'progressing as planned', operational by end Q4 FY27.

ledger.promise: FY27 capex of about 700 crore (frame of 700-1,000 crore a year)
ledger.quote: our capex frame will be in the INR700 crores to INR1,000 crores every year. INR700 crores this year is what we are looking at given where we are.
ledger.actual: Management says H1 FY27 capex was about 300-310 crore, so H2 needs about 390-400. CWIP rose from 143 (FY26) to 317 (FY27 figure).

current_guidance.quote: we are going to be working on the margins that you see for the first half in the same sort of range for the year.
We are not going to change the guidance from 30%

current_guidance.target: Up to 15,000 MTPA R32; commissioning shortly, full ramp-up next quarter
current_guidance.horizon: Q3 FY27 commissioning; Q4 FY27 ramp-up
current_guidance.quote: Our HFC capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning shortly.
The Chemours project, which will enable us to participate in the emerging advanced cooling market, is also progressing towards commissioning in Q3 FY27.

current_guidance.target: 60-65% of PAR in FY27; balance in FY28
current_guidance.quote: For Nectar, we had always clarified that FY27, we would be somewhere around 60%, 65% of the PAR and the balance PAR will come into FY28.
we have always been saying that we will do USD100 million by FY27.
Phase 2 of the cGMP -4 facility involving a capex of approximately INR125 crores is progressing as planned and is expected to become operational by the end of Q4 FY27.
the peak annual revenue potential is close to 3x of the capital or about INR900 crores to INR1,000 crores by FY28, FY29

current_guidance.target: 700-1,000 crore a year; about 700 crore in FY27
current_guidance.quote: our capex frame will be in the INR700 crores to INR1,000 crores every year. INR700 crores this year is what we are looking at given where we are.
Our investment in advanced material adoption capacity is progressing as per schedule and is expected to commission by Q2 FY28.
adds in about close to USD180 million potential for revenue over the next 4 years of the same assets
Advanced Materials will be roughly about 10% to 15% of the expanded pie by 2030.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: On the financial targets, results have beaten guidance: FY26 EBITDA margin was 32.6% against a 'hit or cross 30%' promise, and margins have been 34.2% for three quarters in a row against a 30% ±2% band. On project timing the record is weaker: the Chemours project slipped three times (Q1 FY27 to Q3 FY27), Nectar's full-utilization aim was pushed into FY28, and the CDMO and specialty run-rate claims cannot be checked from these materials.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Margins depend on product mix and should be judged on an annual basis around 30% ±200 bps, not quarter by quarter.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: EBITDA margin was 32.5%, 34.5%, 34.2%, 34.2% and 34.2% from Q2 FY26 to Q2 FY27. That is steady, and it sits above the guided band. Management still keeps 30% as the long-term guide.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Agchem/specialty growth is held back by continued pricing pressure, especially in LatAm, even as volumes recover.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Group revenue grew 44% YoY in Q1 FY27 (1,045 vs 725) and 57% in Q2 FY27 (1,191 vs 758). Gross margin was down about 100 bps but EBITDA margin held at 34.2%. Segment pressure does not show at group level.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Wave-2 projects (MPP debottlenecking, R32, HFC, Chemours) are on track for completion as indicated.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Chemours has slipped from Q1 FY27 to Q3 FY27. R32 had not been commissioned by the Q2 FY27 call. CWIP rose from 143 (FY26) to 317 (FY27 figure), so capital is being spent ahead of commissioning.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Net working capital to improve to 75-80 days from the earlier 90-day guide.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Cash conversion cycle fell from 193 days (FY23) to 89 (FY25) and 60 (FY26). Borrowings fell from 1,466 (FY25) to 1,272 (FY26) and 1,248 (FY27). The numbers are already better than the guide.

bull.point: Results on profitability have come in above guidance and are rising.
bull.evidence: FY26 EBITDA of 1,082 (32.6% margin) vs 534 in FY25. TTM EBITDA is 1,393 at 34.3%. Q2 FY27 PAT of 269 vs 148 in Q2 FY26 is up 82%.

bull.point: Further capacity is close to adding volume, and management describes FY28 growth as largely secured by existing capex.
bull.evidence: R32 is 'commissioning shortly' with full ramp-up next quarter. cGMP-4 Phase 2 is due by end Q4 FY27. Management guides 900-1,000 crore peak revenue from cGMP-4 by FY28-29 and says 'ongoing growth to FY '28 is largely baked in'.
bull.source: Q2 FY27 call p4, p7, p11; Q1 FY27 call p7

bull.point: The balance sheet and cash conversion are improving while capex continues.
bull.evidence: FY26 cash from operations was 894 vs 571 in FY25. Cash conversion cycle fell from 89 to 60 days. Borrowings fell from 1,466 (FY25) to 1,248 (FY27).

bear.point: Project timelines keep slipping, mainly the Chemours project that is meant to open the advanced cooling market.
bear.evidence: Target was Q1 FY27 (Feb 2026), then end June/early July, then end Q2 FY27, then Q3 FY27. Revenue is said to take about two years after start-up.
bear.source: Q3 FY26 call p5, p10; Q4 FY26 call p4; Q1 FY27 call p4; Q2 FY27 call p4

bear.point: Utilization ramps are slower than first stated.
bear.evidence: Nectar went from aiming to secure the other half in FY27 to 60-65% of PAR in FY27 with the rest in FY28. Management called the agchem plant qualification 'slower than what we would have liked'. The HFO plant needs 'more time to kind of hit the full capacity'.
bear.source: Q3 FY26 call p12; Q4 FY26 call p16, p18; Q2 FY27 call p10, p12

bear.point: Management still guides margins of 30%, below today's 34% level, and capex is heavy compared with operating cash flow.
bear.evidence: The long-term 30% guide is kept despite 34.2% H1 FY27 margins. FY26 investing outflow of 1,235 was more than cash from operations of 894. FY27 capex is guided at about 700 crore, with 700-1,000 crore a year after that.
bear.source: Q2 FY27 call p11, p12; reported numbers
